title: State of Emergency
description: Survivors band together after an explosion at a military bioweapons plant turns most of their neighbors into flesh-eating zombies.

title: Deadsight
description: A pregnant police officer and a blind man fight for their lives against swarms of the living dead.

title: Feral
description: A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.

title: #Horror
description: Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.

title: Airborne
description: A plane takes off during a snowstorm and soon reports both pilots are dead. As the passengers slowly die off, they wish they had never left the ground.

title: Yummy
description: A young couple travel to a shabby Eastern European hospital for plastic surgery. Once there, things unravel into blood and violence.

title: Hatching
description: After finding a wounded bird, a girl brings its strange egg home and nurtures it until it hatches. The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging her into a twisted reality that her mother refuses to see.

title: The Pact
description: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

title: The Dead Room
description: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

title: Centigrade
description: A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.

title: #Horror
description: Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.

title: The Babadook
description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

title: I Trapped the Devil
description: Hoping for a joyful family reunion, Matt and his wife pay a surprise visit to the home of his estranged brother, Steve, to celebrate Christmas. To their shock, they soon learn that Steve has a hostage in his basement -- a man he claims is the devil.

title: They Live in the Grey
description: While investigating a child abuse case, a young social worker discovers that the family is being tormented by a supernatural entity. In order to save the parents from losing custody of their child, she must stop the malevolent force.

title: A Wounded Fawn
description: A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

title: Skeletons in the Closet
description: A woman becomes possessed by an evil spirit after she saves the life of her terminally ill daughter.

title: Anything for Jackson
description: A sinister couple hatch a supernatural scheme to resurrect their dead grandson through a pregnant woman.

title: The Night
description: A couple become trapped inside a hotel with their demons -- real and imagined -- until they can confront the secrets of their marriage.

title: Kindred
description: Plagued by mysterious hallucinations, a pregnant woman suspects that the family of her deceased boyfriend has intentions for her unborn child.

title: Mandy
description: An outsider seeks bloody vengeance against the sadistic cult leader who destroyed his peaceful existence.

title: Spoonful of Sugar
description: A disturbed babysitter experiences a sexual awakening while using LSD to treat a seemingly sick child from a family with dark secrets.

title: Watcher
description: As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.

title: Black Cab
description: After a night out, a couple are kidnapped by their black cab driver. Terrified, he drives them to a deserted and supposedly haunted road.

title: Z
description: A boy's imaginary friend terrorizes his family.

title: You'll Never Find Me
description: On a stormy night, a mysterious woman asks for shelter at Patrick's mobile home. Their anxiety and mutual mistrust grow as the night unfolds, causing fear and paranoia to engulf the small RV.

title: The Reef
description: A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

title: The Reef: Stalked
description: Hoping to heal from a tragedy, a woman and her friends embark on a kayaking and diving adventure in tropical waters. However, the fun soon turns to terror when they find themselves fighting for their lives against a great white shark.

title: Night of the Hunted
description: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

title: Dark Touch
description: In a remote Irish village, police are called to the scene of a massacre, but they ignore the lone survivor's claim that the house was responsible for the carnage.

title: Lake of Death
description: Lillian and some friends travel back to the remote family cabin where her twin brother died the previous year. Soon, strange things start happening.

title: Pyewacket
description: A frustrated, angst-ridden teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to evoke a witch to kill her mother.

title: Soul's Midnight
description: A man (Robert Floyd) must save his pregnant wife from a band of vampires who practice human sacrifice.

title: Elevator Game
description: A teen links the mysterious disappearance of his sister to a supernatural game that's played in elevators.

title: Birth/Rebirth
description: A morgue technician reanimates the body of a little girl, but must harvest biological materials from pregnant women to keep her breathing. When the girl's mother, a nurse, discovers her baby is alive, the two make a dark deal.

title: Baghead
description: A young woman inherits a run-down pub and discovers a dark secret within its basement, Baghead, a shape-shifting creature that lets one speak to lost loved ones, but not without consequence.

title: Relic
description: A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

title: Resurrection
description: A woman's carefully constructed life gets upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.

title: The Unheard
description: After undergoing an experimental procedure to restore her damaged hearing, 20-year-old Chloe Grayden begins to suffer from auditory hallucinations seemingly related to the mysterious disappearance of her mother.

title: Z
description: A boy's imaginary friend terrorizes his family.

title: Perpetrator
description: Jonny Baptiste is sent to live with her estranged Aunt Hildie. On her 18th birthday, she experiences a family spell that redefines her, called Forevering. When several girls go missing at school, a feral Jonny hunts the perpetrator.
